editorial:
Imagine moving to a giant city where you do not know a single soul. That is exactly where you find the main character in this story. He is lonely, tired, and just wants someone to talk to, so he decides to try a hookup app. It starts as a quick way to meet people, but it quickly turns into something much deeper. You will feel for him as he navigates the awkwardness of modern dating and the fear of actually letting someone see who he really is. The movie has a soft, warm vibe that makes the lonely parts feel real but still hopeful.

The acting is the best part here because the lead makes you feel every bit of his sadness and joy. The pacing is a bit slow at first, but once the romance kicks in, you will be totally hooked. If you are into stories about finding love in weird places, you need to see this.
endingExplained: At the end, the main character discovers that the woman he has been messaging is actually his neighbor from across the hall. They had both been too shy to speak in person for months. In the final scene, they finally meet face-to-face in the hallway and share a long hug. The movie wraps up with them walking into the sunlight together, showing that he is no longer alone in the big city.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves heartwarming stories about lonely people finding love.
